'''Wuta''' was a wind tree spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology, known for constantly seeking lost items for his "making" (a project he never finishes). "Wuta" was a popular name for male [[Wokling/Legends|Ewok children]],<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Wuta|the Ewok scout]] who fought in the [[Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Wuta was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
